reasoning: Context captures exact current native page/document token before adoption; runtime_host.cc3063–3105 independently binds original regular native window/profile/page and connection before calling AdoptSessionPage. Existing same-scope branch validates borrowed token/run/task/ancestry and returns before reset, so it cannot clear a running scope transition marker.

New branch refuses residual lease or navigation_transition_id before Reserve/Register. The reset executes only after existing actual partition/run-intent/runtime generation/ancestry checks succeed in RegisterIsolation. It changes only prior installed_document_token bookkeeping; native new lease still needs exact current frame/documentToken/origin/isolation/run/task/controlGeneration/expiry.

Old document EgressDocument.protection remains guarded; credential_run_id remains on actual document and Install still refuses a different run in a credential-bearing same document. Fresh human B cannot gain authority from A token. Source document protection, opaque transport state, person/takeover flags and old credential records are not reset by proposed line.

ReleaseIsolation clears original lease/transition and rotates control generation; CancelChecks erases original pending/in_flight entries before invoking denial callbacks. Later responses holding those IDs cannot dispatch/replay. Current checks require live current primary frame/document plus exact current run/isolation/lease identity.

RegisterIsolation sends authority_observers_.Notify synchronously before returning. Actual observers read/revoke mapped input authority or enqueue Worker notification; reviewed current concrete callbacks do not synchronously install a new lease or replace original page between registration and reset. No new external callback is added. Existing AdoptSessionPage already performs post-Register borrowed-map/state writes; a new mutating subscriber would require re-review, not a blanket claim of arbitrary reentrant safety.

ReserveIsolation itself only returns a candidate ID/config on fresh run; a rejected Register cannot reach the reset. Existing successful registration/observer publication followed by end Context failure has no new rollback path in this proposal; it remains fail-closed guarded state and requires original cleanup. No success/cleanup proof is invented.
precision: For A→B navigation, A old WeakDocument/current-primary contexts and original captured lease callbacks remain refused. Do not overclaim that every future same-document old factory request is permanently refused: EgressRequestContext contains document/page/protection, not an original lease/generation; Check obtains the current lease, so a genuinely re-admitted same document can produce new requests under new-run projection/approval. This existing semantic is not changed by clearing marker.

An empty old lease is retirement evidence only within native existing original lifecycle; it is not provider/write completion or complete pending receipt proof. Active old isolation hits reuse/ownership refusal before new branch.
Current observed filtered metadata proves source identity shape and no extra-page expansion, not execution of proposed native source. No approximate old symbols/crash claim or mirror-test evidence.
